newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell Singapore shuts secondary units for a week.
newsitem.headline: Shell Singapore shuts secondary units for a week.

text.p: Shell Singapore has shut down half of its 11,000 tonne-per-day (82,000-barrel-per-day) thermal gas oil unit at its Bukom refinery for a week since March 2, a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
Shell will also shut a 4,400-tonne-per-day (32,780-bpd) hydrocracker unit for a week from March 5. The shutdowns were due to technical problems at the units, the spokeswoman said.
"We need to shutdown to attend to some technical problems," she said.
The problems at the thermal gas oil unit has resulted in a production loss of some 5,000 tonnes per day (37,250 bpd), the spokeswoman said.
Shell earlier shut its 11,000-tonne-per-day thermal cracker from January 13-24 for routine maintenance.
Shell has restored its 435,000-bpd refinery to normal production on February 21 after it was reduced by 4,000 tonnes per day on January 17.
